turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. My son found out he had a zero from the online gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. I have a client call at 4:40, so tell me who decided this and why nobody called me first.
Thanks for coming in.
I didn't come to be thanked, Hale. Answer the question.
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk about it. What did you decide, and on what basis?
How has his semester been at home?
His semester at home is not what I came to discuss. Why is that your question, when you put a zero on his mark?
He seems tired in class lately.
Tired isn't evidence of anything, Hale. I'm writing down that you raised it. What do you actually have?
I know he works at the grocery store.
Plenty of Grade 12 students have jobs. Is that now a reason to put a zero on his mark, Hale?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
On time, and now a zero. So what is wrong with it, Hale?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." You entered a zero for some concerns. Did you speak to Owen before you did that, or to me?
The school's checker flagged it.

"A machine's guess. The company that makes it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern. So what else do you have, Hale?"
I know those tools aren't perfect.
Then you entered a zero on a tool you knew wasn't reliable. Withdraw it, Hale.
I also looked at the version history.
And what does it show, Hale?
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late" is an adjective, Hale, not a time. Students work late, and that proves nothing.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." I'm writing that down. What time, exactly, and how big?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After you entered the zero, or before it?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Trouble explaining" is an impression, Hale, not a document. And you still haven't answered whether you spoke to him before the zero.
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Intentions aren't a document, Hale. Answer my question, or withdraw the zero.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, apologize to Owen, and then we'll see whether I still need the principal.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not in your chair, Hale, and I'm not going to do your thinking for you. I told you what I want. Do it.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
A rewrite of what, Hale? You haven't shown me one document that justifies the zero. I have two minutes.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Lunch in your room isn't something I've agreed to. The zero comes off today and you apologize to Owen, and until you do, I'm walking upstairs to the principal. Your answer, Hale.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Nothing goes on his file, Hale, and there's no condition on that. Where's the zero?
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms haven't changed: the zero comes off, you apologize to Owen, and nothing goes on his file.
Thanks for your time.
I haven't agreed to anything, Hale. Is the zero coming off today, or am I going upstairs?
